text:
You need a detail-oriented Business Development Assistant who can research prospects, manage leads, support the CEO’s meeting pipeline, and help create proposals while keeping the sales process moving forward.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with hands-on work in SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my background is data-focused, the work has consistently required the same discipline your role depends on: careful research, organized follow-through, clear reporting, and strong attention to detail across multiple moving pieces.

In a recent project for Marlowe Furniture, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. That consolidation improved the monthly close reporting process from 3 days to 4 hours. This kind of work taught me how to organize complex information, spot what matters quickly, and present it in a way that helps decision-makers act faster.

I also worked on a GA4 migration and tracking plan for Verdant Skincare, where I built the tracking plan and GTM setup to move the shop from Universal Analytics to GA4 before the cut-off. We mapped 46 events and maintained no gap in year-on-year reporting. That project strengthened my ability to manage detail-heavy work, coordinate information accurately, and keep processes moving without disruption.

For True Synergy, I would bring that same structured approach to prospect research, lead tracking, meeting preparation, and proposal support. I’m comfortable working through lists, cleaning and organizing data, and making sure follow-up is handled consistently. I also understand the value of clear communication and dependable execution in a client-facing role, especially in a consulting environment where professionalism and precision matter.

I’d be glad to support your CEO by helping keep prospects organized, research thorough, and proposals well-prepared so more opportunities move smoothly through the sales process.
